    - heading "What is Amazon CloudWatch?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon CloudWatch is AWS's fully managed monitoring and observability service that collects and visualizes metrics, logs, and traces across your entire AWS environment. It provides real-time visibility into resource utilization, application performance, and operational health, enabling teams to detect anomalies, set alarms, and automate responses before issues reach end users. With native integrations across virtually every AWS service, CloudWatch offers capabilities like composite alarms, anomaly detection, and cross-account observability. As workloads become increasingly AI-driven, CloudWatch also delivers purpose-built AI and agent observability, helping teams monitor model inference performance, trace multi-step agent workflows, and pinpoint failures across complex, autonomous systems. Whether you're running a single EC2 instance or operating distributed, AI-powered applications at scale, CloudWatch provides the unified intelligence you need to keep everything running reliably.
    - 'link "Learn more about CloudWatch Omni: What is Amazon CloudWatch?"':
      - /url: /cloudwatch/omni/
      - text: Learn more about CloudWatch Omni
    - heading [level=2]
    - paragraph
    - img "Missing alt text value"
    - heading "See everything in one place" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Get a unified view of your generative AI agents, applications, workloads, and the infrastructure that powers them. CloudWatch connects metrics, logs, and traces to help you quickly understand relationships, spot performance bottlenecks, and uncover hidden dependencies without jumping between tools.
    - paragraph: CloudWatch Omni, the next generation of CloudWatch offers a re-imagined, AI-powered observability experience built on open standards and delivered where you already work. It embraces openness at its core, working with your existing stack, frameworks, and languages through native OpenTelemetry support. Developers building AI agents get eval-driven observability with continuous quality signals on every invocation, right inside VS Code, Kiro, or Cursor. Operators get application-centric intelligence with auto topology discovery, AI-powered investigation, and fleet-level dashboards, no AWS Console required. The result is one unified experience where you can see agent behavior alongside your applications, all observable from a single place.
    - paragraph:

    - heading "AI and Agent Observability" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Monitor your AI agents with the same confidence you monitor your applications. CloudWatch provides purpose-built observability for AI workloads, giving you full visibility into agent execution paths, model inference performance, and multi-step workflows. Trace every invocation end to end, run continuous evaluations on real user sessions, and pinpoint failures across complex, autonomous systems. With native support for popular agent frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Strands, CloudWatch works with your existing stack through OpenTelemetry.

See agent behavior alongside your applications in one unified view, with eval-driven quality signals that close the observe-evaluate-iterate loop right where you build."
